title: UPSC NDA II Admit Card 2026 – Out
postName: National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026
vacancyDetails: Army 208, Navy 42, Air Force 120 and Naval Academy 24 posts.
qualification: Army Wing: 10+2 pass or appearing from a recognized board. Air Force and Naval Wings: 10+2 pass or appearing with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
ageLimit: Date of birth must be between 01 January 2008 and 01 January 2011, both dates inclusive, as per UPSC NDA-II rules.
applicationFee: General/OBC: Rs.100. SC/ST and all female candidates: Rs.0.
selectionProcess: Written Examination → SSB Interview → Document Verification → Medical Examination.
documentsRequired: Registration number, password or date of birth, photo ID and printed admit card
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in/
2. Open the NDA and NA Examination (II), 2026 admit card link
3. Sign in through the candidate portal
4. Download the admit card and check exam date, timing and instructions

shortDescription: UPSC NDA II Admit Card 2026 is available from 03 September 2026. The National Defence Academy and Naval Academy II Examination is scheduled for 13 September 2026.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026 Admit Card.

The admit card is available from 03 September 2026 and the written examination is scheduled for 13 September 2026. Download it through the official UPSC Online candidate portal and verify the centre, reporting time and instructions.

Vacancy details

  • Army: 208
  • Navy: 42
  • Air Force: 120
  • Naval Academy: 24
  • Total: 394 posts

How to download

  1. Open the official UPSC Online admit-card link.
  2. Sign in through the candidate portal.
  3. Download and print the admit card.
  4. Carry the printed admit card and valid photo ID to the examination centre.
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I verify UPSC NDA II Exam Schedule 2026?
faqs.answer: Use the official website: https://upsc.gov.in. This page only points you there.

faqs.question: Are the dates on this page final?
faqs.answer: No. Treat every date as a prompt to re-check the latest PDF or login dashboard on the official portal.
